data.narrative:
SirenOpt is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $19M to date. The comparable universe consists of 9 private robotics peers and 1 public company (277810.KQ), including firms such as Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Stage-progression analysis is the primary applicable method, using the $19M total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement. This produces an implied valuation of $48M. The peer-median approach was not applicable; while 11 same-sector peers exist in robotics and manufacturing, insufficient clustering emerged within narrow filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables), requiring at least 3 datapoints for reliable median estimation.

The triangulated range spans $40M (low) to $55M (high), with a median of $48M. This range reflects the stage-progression method in isolation, given the limited peer comparability. Key uncertainties include the absence of a tight peer set at identical stage and valuation tier, which constrains confidence in anchoring multiples. The valuation is sensitive to assumed step-up magnitude and the true post-seed funding environment for frontier robotics. Additional clarity on revenue traction, customer concentration, and technical differentiation would strengthen conviction in placement within this band.
